reason: I'd use the free first visit on a Saturday and probably come back once or twice at most. The place looks nice, but it's not something I'd build a routine around.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, so a membership isn't worth it, and $15 a visit per kid adds up fast with two kids when other play spots cost less.
would_change_my_mind: Weekend pricing that's cheaper than $15 a child, or a pack that doesn't expire, so I only pay for the visits I actually make.
